name: Infertility
overview: Scripture reveals that God blesses His people with fruitfulness, commanding them to be fruitful and multiply as seen in Genesis 1:28, yet He also sovereignly allows barrenness, as in the case of Rebekah, whom God enabled to conceive after Isaac's prayer (Genesis 25:21). The Old Testament promises blessing that includes the absence of barrenness among the people and their livestock (Deuteronomy 7:14; Exodus 23:26), highlighting God's provision and care. While infertility can be a trial, the Lord uses it to humble and test the heart, refining faith and obedience (Deuteronomy 8:2). Ultimately, God is able to make the barren woman a joyful mother, demonstrating His power to bless and fulfill His promises (Psalms 113:9).
